about: Tests that replace a speech or tool-registry boundary (speak, speakToClients, sendToRole, a toolRegistryV2 method, or tests/fakeTts.ts). Each must be listed here with what it replaces and why; tests/boundaryDoublesTest.ts fails on any unlisted or stale entry. A stand-in once hid real defects at exactly these boundaries (BUG-02, VOICE-001).

tests/agentSpecialistsTest.ts.reason: wraps execute only to record which tools the specialists call, then calls the real execute

tests/approvalBudgetR31Test.ts.reason: speakToClients sets playback times so that a spoken approval question is still being said when its call is cancelled (§7, the voice wait must end at once), records what would be said (§8, a withdrawn question is not said) and sets playback times taken after a system clock change (§9); the real bridge-to-tts.py path is tested by realTtsHandoffTest

tests/approvalGateStructuredTest.ts.reason: speakToClients records the spoken approval question and sets playback times, to check when the answer window opens; the real bridge-to-tts.py path is tested by realTtsHandoffTest; uses tests/fakeTts.ts: the real orchestrator.speak() and state machine run; only tts.py is replaced, by a stand-in that reports playback
